book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: Tup ŋendehei ŋaiye Pol nainge nal lenge Korin

content: Yip pa junde yaŋah ŋam tuꞌe ŋaiye ŋam gwande Krais.
Pol ŋanange ŋaiye lenge tuweinge ka yaparaꞌe ŋondoh tinge
Ŋam hriphrip me yip supule, detale, nye nyermbe yip ŋoiheryembe ŋam, topoꞌe yip jande yaŋah tikin Lahmborenge ŋaiye ŋam yasam yip.
Kom ŋam masande yip pa sisyeme tuꞌe leꞌe, Krais kin ŋondoh me lenge miyeꞌ lalme, o miyeꞌ kin ŋondoh me tuwei kin, kut Got kin ŋondoh me Krais.
Ŋaiye miyeꞌ ka aparaꞌe ŋondoh kin no, ka isilihme Yai, lakai ka ininge wusyep profet ende pe, luku kin naŋaꞌe hiꞌe nalme Krais ŋaiye kin miyeꞌ ondoh poi.

Topoꞌe ŋaiye tuwei ende yukur waparaꞌe ŋondoh ti no, ti wisilihme Yai, lakai ti wanange wusyep profet ende gwan halhale pe, luku ti ta waŋaꞌe hiꞌe wilme miyeꞌ ti. Luku pe, ki ŋahilyeh taꞌe tuwei ŋaiye ti si wainge ŋondoh ti.
Ŋaiye tuwei yukur waparaꞌe ŋondoh ti pe, ta wotombo ŋondoh waih ti ka seheiꞌe. Kom ŋaiye ta hiꞌe ŋaiye ta winge pe, ta waparaꞌe ŋondoh ti.
Miyeꞌ kin taꞌe yipihinge ŋaiye ŋasambe naŋ embere topoꞌe bongol tikin Got pe, yukur ka aparaꞌe ŋondoh kin, kut tuwei ti wasambe naŋ embere topoꞌe bongol ŋaiye miyeꞌ ti.
Got yukur nenge wahriꞌ tuwei ŋende miyeꞌ, pakai. Kin nenge wahriꞌ miyeꞌ ŋende tuwei.
Got yukur ŋoiheryembe tuwei no, kin ŋende miyeꞌ ŋaiye ka ungwisme ti, pakai. Kin ŋoiheryembe miyeꞌ pe, ki ŋende tuwei ŋaiye ta wungwisme kin.
Taꞌe luku pe, tuwei ta waparaꞌe ŋondoh ti no, luku ka sasambe tuꞌe ŋaiye ti warp tuwihme miyeꞌ ti. Detale, ŋembep lenge walip hlaꞌ sai.
Kom poi miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin Got pe, tuwei yukur ta wurp tititi, topoꞌe miyeꞌ yukur ka orp kitikin, pakai.
Ŋendeheiyeh Got nenge wahriꞌ miyeꞌ ŋende tuwei, kom tukwini tuwei waraꞌe miyeꞌ. Kom ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme luku pe, Got kin tehei.
Yip ŋoiheryembe taꞌe lai me wusyep eꞌe, ŋaiye tuwei yukur waparaꞌe ŋondoh ti no, ti wisilihme Yai gwan halhale pe, luku ki bwore lakai?
Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge yanange nange ki hiꞌe, ŋaiye dohwaih lenge miyeꞌ ka sokoloh.
Kom ŋaiye tuwei dohwaih ti sokoloh pe, luku taꞌe ŋaiye hihyilih ti. Detale, tinge yaŋaꞌe dohwaih sokoloh ŋaiye ka aparaꞌe ŋondoh ti.
Kom ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende ka ininge nange wusyep eꞌe ŋaiye ŋam manange ki homboꞌe pe, ŋam da mininge tuꞌe leꞌe. Poi yukur gwande yaŋah ŋoinde, topoꞌe sios tikin Got yukur jande yaŋah ŋoinde, pakai.
Lenge Korin yambaꞌe ŋai tikin Lahmborenge, kom tinge yukur ŋoiheryembe mitiŋ syeꞌ
Ŋupe ŋaiye yip jahilyeh yende lotu pe, yip si yende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiye yukur bwore pe, ŋam yukur hriphrip, kom leꞌe wusyep erŋeme ŋam ŋaiye pa yende junde.
Ŋendeheiyeh kin lenge mitiŋ syeꞌ yana ŋam nange ŋupe ŋaiye yip jahilyeh yende lotu pe, yip yoworꞌe yip tip hoime pe, yip teketenge yale yat yiptip. Pe luku ŋam sisyeme nange wusyep syeꞌ mise.
Yip yoworꞌe yip tip hoime pe, luku ki bwore ŋaiye ki sasambe ŋaiye lahmende bwore mise, o lahmende homboꞌe.
Ŋupe ŋaiye yip jahilyeh yende lotu pe, yaŋah ŋaiye yip yambaꞌe ŋai tikin Lahmborenge pe, yukur bwore bwarme, pakai.
Yip ŋoiheryembe yip tip pe, yip hri yono ŋai yiptip, o lenge syeꞌ pe, nimbot nongomb lenge, topoꞌe lenge syeꞌ pe, tinge yonoꞌe pinip wain ŋembere sekete pe, tinge kwote.

Detaꞌe la? Taꞌe yip yokoh ŋaiye pa yono ŋai topoꞌe yonoꞌe pinip yurp pakai, lakai? Yip ŋoiheryembe nange sios tikin Got pupwa luh pakaiye pe, yip yende hiꞌ me lenge toꞌ tatai ŋaiye seheiꞌme ŋai ŋaiye tinge ka yono. Pe ma mini yip tuꞌe la? Ma mininge wusyep hriphrip me yip lakai? Ŋaiye yip yende taꞌe luku pe, yukur ma mininge wusyep hriphrip me yip, pakai supule.
Ŋam si yal yip wusyep ŋaiye ŋam mambaꞌ me Lahmborenge. Wusyep uku ki taꞌe leꞌe: Ŋupe ŋaiye Judas nember Jisas nal syep lenge wachaih, ŋup uku pe, Lahmborenge Jisas nambaꞌe kakah.
Pe kin ŋanange wusyep hriphrip nalme Got miꞌe pe, kin noworꞌe kakah pe, ki ŋanange na, “Leꞌe wahriꞌ ŋam, ŋam yal yip ŋaiye ka ungwisme yip. Yip pa yende tuꞌe luku no, pa ŋoiheryembe ŋam.”

Ŋupe ŋaiye tinge yono ŋai miꞌe pe, ki ŋende ŋahilyeh. Kin nambaꞌe yokoh wain pe, ki ŋanange na, “Yokoh wain eꞌe pe, kontrak ŋambaran tikin Got ŋaiye ŋam menge wim ŋam mupwaiꞌe. Nye nyermbe ŋupe ŋaiye pa yonoꞌe juh yokoh eꞌe pe, pa yende tuꞌe luku ŋaiye pa ŋoiheryembe ŋam.”
Nyermbe nyermbe ŋaiye pa yono kakah uku topoꞌe pa yonoꞌe pinip juh yokoh eꞌe pe, pa yininge nule tikin Lahmborenge ka e tutume ŋupe ŋaiye ka ot.
Poi ya miyarꞌe ŋoihmbwaip poi bworere ti, ya mambaꞌe ŋai tikin Lahmborenge
Taꞌe luku pe, lahmende ŋaiye kin ŋoiheryembe ŋaiye wim topoꞌe wahriꞌ tikin Lahmborenge pupwa luh pakaiye no, ka ambaꞌe ŋai uku pe, kin ŋende hwap nalme wahriꞌ topoꞌe wim tikin Lahmborenge.
Miyeꞌ ŋaiye da ono kakah topoꞌe onoꞌe wain tikin Lahmborenge pe, kin ka iyarꞌe oto ŋoihmbwaip kitikin bworerme.
Ŋaiye miyeꞌ yukur sisyeme tehei ŋai uku ŋaiye wahriꞌ tikin Lahmborenge no, kin ŋono ŋai topoꞌe kin ŋonoꞌe pinip pe, Got se ka aŋaꞌe nihe syohme kin.
Luku tehei kin ŋaiye wula yip yende wahriꞌ epwa, topoꞌe bongol yip pakai, topoꞌe syeꞌ tinge si yule.
Ŋaiye poi ya miyarꞌe poi pe, yukur Lahmborenge se ka pul poi nihe syohe, pakai.
Kom ŋaiye Lahmborenge kin ŋetekeꞌe poi mende pupwa no, ki pwal poi mane pe, kin ŋende taꞌe luku ŋaiye ka ungwisme poi no, yukur poi ya talai topoꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge kekep.
Taꞌe luku pe, lenge toꞌ tatai ŋam, ŋupe ŋaiye pa juhilyeh yono ŋai tikin Lahmborenge pe, ter pa yeseperhme lenge syeꞌ.

Ŋaiye iyeꞌ ende ka isyunde nimbot pe, ka ono ŋai orp yokoh kitikin. No yukur ka plihe ende pupwa ŋupe ŋaiye pa lalme juhilyeh no, Got ka iyarꞌe kin ŋaiye kin si ŋende pupwa pe, Got ka ende yumbune kin. Ma mininge wusyep me ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe syeꞌ ŋupe ŋaiye ma mut.
